payload.blocks: Nothing blocks; this only frees disk and keeps `git worktree list` true. All phases continue.
payload.headline: Remove the two kept component-authority-doors worktrees (-p5c, -p8) whose work is already on main?

parts.cause: No head grant holds `worktree remove` (supervisor and lead lack it) and no unconfined lead:SUPERVISOR session is live, so only the owner can run the removal.

options.does: Run `fgos worktree remove /home/vantt/projects/forgent-worktrees/261121-2110-component-authority-doors-p5c --discard-ignored --discard` and the same for -p8.
options.gain: Clean worktree list; no stale dirty edits confused for live work.
options.harm: The superseded uncommitted p5c edits are lost (already replaced by 339a43126).
options.label: A. Owner removes both with --discard

options.does: Leave both worktrees in place until a later cleanup sweep.
options.harm: Stale dirty worktree stays and may mislead a later session.
options.label: B. Keep them for now

parts.recommendation: A: both branches' work is on main and the p5c edits are superseded.

scope.allows: Removing only these two worktrees and their branches.
scope.forbids: Removing any other worktree or touching main.

parts.what: The lead kept worktrees 261121-2110-component-authority-doors-p5c (dirty with superseded edits, no commits) and -p8 after landing 339a43126 and 7d084487a, and handed them to the supervisor.
